pattern: a knurl's teeth derived from DIN 82, which Python's intent does not state
evidence: The maintainer's decision Q4/Q15 (docs/questions.md): AP242's turned_knurl needs at least three of number of teeth, tooth depth, root fillet, helix angle and hand beside the diameters and pitch (WR2; a diamond's helix angle, WR9), so the Rust rules derive them from the knurling standard and state each in the intent with its source, visible and editable ('standard': 'DIN 82', 'derived': key to source). Values: teeth round(pi x 10 / 1) = 31, the pitch kept at the tool's 1 mm; tooth depth P/2 = 0.5, the depth of DIN 82's 90 degree profile (IS 3403:1981 3.1; assumed, no table gives it); root fillet 0.1, the knurling wheel's crest radius up to 1 mm pitch (IS 6776:1980 4.3); a diamond's helix angle 30 degrees and no hand (DIN 82 type RGE). Checked in tests/threads.rs. Python's knurl states pattern, pitch and diameter only.

pattern: axis-first turned datum defaults and their dependent questions and intent
evidence: Axis-first turned datums: largest recognised principal diameter (area breaks ties), then a perpendicular contact/largest shoulder. Axial holes use diametral position to A alone; other holes keep the full frame. Runout uses A and is not offered on the datum diameter itself. A mostly prismatic body or different principal axes keeps plane datums. tests/turned_defaults.rs checks captured and live corpus geometry, overrides, offsets, cross holes and shoulder contacts. tests/fixtures/turned_defaults_oracle.json.gz is an additional exact regression guard on EVERY changed path and both values (including question ordering and all other rules); rules_oracle asserts that complete list before applying these verdict entries, so these scopes cannot hide further differences. See docs/turned-defaults.md.

Through and unknown depths keep their prior summaries. tests/thread_depth_help.rs tests discovery, defaults, explicit depths and limits. Every changed path and both old/new values are exactly pinned by tests/fixtures/turned_defaults_oracle.json.gz before these entries apply.
